name: Neck Flexion with Band
summary: A gentle neck exercise that uses a resistance band to train the muscles at the front of the neck. A good low-load starting point for neck training.
setup: Anchor a light band at head height and loop it around your forehead or hold it against the forehead.
Face away from the anchor, stand tall and step forward until the band has light tension.
Keep the shoulders relaxed and the chin slightly tucked.
execution: Slowly nod the head forward against the band's pull.
Pause briefly, then return to neutral in control.
Keep the movement small and smooth.
Repeat for 10-15 reps. Stop if you feel dizzy, numb or sharp pain.
mistakes: Using a band that is too strong: choose very light tension.
Letting the shoulders hike up: relax the shoulders and stand tall.
Jerking the head forward: move slowly through a small range.
